dataset.text: Patient presented with acute myocardial infarction and elevated troponin biomarkers.
Histopathological examination confirmed benign follicular adenoma in the thyroid gland.
Prescribed intravenous cephalosporin antibiotic regimen to treat bacterial meningitis.
Contrast-enhanced MRI revealed no signs of cerebral edema or ischemic stroke.
Cardiopulmonary bypass was maintained during open-heart coronary artery graft surgery.
